content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a missing implementation for handling the '--help' option in the command-line argument parsing of the `qemu-img` tool. Specifically, the code did not recognize the '--help' option as a valid command, which resulted in the help message not being printed when the user invoked the command with this option. This issue was introduced in a previous commit (ac1307ab) and was fixed by adding the necessary logic to check for the '--help' option and call the appropriate help function.
